name: The Unwritten Consignment
description: A four-act frontier mini-campaign for SpriteQuest. Cold crates, cryogenic coffins, epistemic warrants, and literal wishes.

acts.name: Act I: The Cold Crate at the Customs House
acts.description: Rain needles the zinc roof. Inside the Intake Foyer, hoarfrost creeps from under the iron wicket of the Forfeit Corridor. Hollis furiously taps his 1588 bell-weight while Factor Vane watches an hourglass.

acts.name: Act II: The Watch on the Overhang & The Grey Wind's Bargain
acts.description: Outside the Customs House, the frontier rises in steep stepped strata of slate. Factor Vane hauls the stasis coffin while Orom steps forth from solid granite.

acts.name: Act III: The Climb That Is Not On Any Plan
acts.description: Past the northern milestone, cobblestones stop. Faint brass plumb-lines hang over unrendered void. Epistemic warfare between Canon Warrants and Entropy Beacons.

acts.name: Act IV: The Glass Cathedral in the Sky
acts.description: A cathedral 240m long blown from a single asteroid. Factor Vane aims the Astronomical Lens while the Frost Monarch awakens from superfluid.
